reviews.review_description:
In this game, you swing your arms to run, jump, grab, and shoot while various creatures chase you. Avoid obstacles, shoot enemies out of the way and collect coins for a boost, and dash to the end, maintaining a high speed before it's game over!

With a variety of levels and creatures to run from, plus different game modes and challenges, this game will keep you in shape as you work off those extra treats from the holiday season, and setting a high score means you will be able to have even more of a challenge running against friends' and family's leaderboard times. 

Definitely check this one out if you like to get some good exercise while improving your reaction time and shooting accuracy in VR. 

Check out my video here: https://youtu.be/FiG7tdLvHjg

reviews.review_title: Both great fun and a fantastic workout!
reviews.review_description: I didn’t expect to enjoy this game as much as I do. Addictive gameplay and a serious workout. I’m not one for the gym but this is a great way to exercise while having fun, you don’t realise how much you are working your body until you feel it the next day.  Flat screen footage can’t do it justice. It has that, “just one more go” thing going on, even if my body tells me it’s had enough!

reviews.review_title: RUNNING RUNNING I RUN FOR YOU
reviews.review_description:
I have had this game for a while now, due to the meta glitch, I have not been able to leave a review and support the dev, who has worked tirelessly to bring this game to us.
Tweaked every small flaw. Now we have a great fun journey through some iconic scenes, my arms literally drop off as the action is so intense, to see the creature getting closer & closer, I put in a spurt to gain some distance between me the the monster chasing me.

For anyone who likes to be completely immersed in this game, don’t hesitate to jump in, graphics are neat, gameplay really works well, if you can stay calm and focused and not panic.

Really enjoying my time in RUNNING SCARED
Recommend to anyone who wants something a little different on the Quest.

Running Scared is a meticulously crafted game where, as the name suggests, you RUN SCARED! And trust me, you'll be doing plenty of that. Wave your arms to sprint, turn around if you dare to check just how close your terrifying pursuer is, shoot your way through obstacles, squat, dodge, and jump over gaps to survive. It's an intense, physical experience that keeps you moving from beginning to end.

One of the great things about this game is the ability to play in either VR or mixed reality (MR). The varied environments and different Egyptian gods chasing you keep things fresh, while the combination of running, shooting, and dodging creates an exciting gameplay loop. It's fun, frantic, and a surprisingly good workout!

As a beta tester, I've had the pleasure of following this game from the beginning, and it's been excellent from the very start. It's great to see a solo developer deliver such a high-quality experience and continue introducing small but meaningful improvements to refine the gameplay.

The execution is solid, the action is engaging, and the physical mechanics make you feel genuinely involved in the chase. Whether you're sprinting for your life in VR or bringing the action into your own room with MR, there's plenty of fun to be had.

A fantastic example of what a dedicated solo developer can achieve. If you enjoy fast-paced action, physical gameplay, and the thrill of being chased by ancient Egyptian gods, Running Scared is well worth checking out. Highly recommended!

reviews.review_title: It's nice to have something different
reviews.review_description:
I don't think I've played a game quite like this on the Quest 3, so thats a bonus that this solo Dev has actually made something unique, and well made it is. Run for your life! actually swing your arms to run, tilt your head to dodge left or right, throw your hands in the air to jump, crouch to slide, this game will give you a workout as well as fun.
Keep turning, use your gun to slow whatever chasing you down.

You can check out my videos on this game if you search Gotcha VR on Youtube.
Treat yourself for Halloween and pick this up, burn off all the Candy you made from Trick or treating.

Ich hab früher gerne Temple Run auf den Handy gespielt - das Spiel ist quasi das VR Äquivalent dazu - man läuft von einem Monster dazu und weicht Zeugs aus, aber mit vollen Körpereinsatz - ganz schön Schweißtreibend. Macht richtig Laune, ist aus meiner Sicht auch eine coole Möglichkeit VR an Leute zu zeigen, die noch nie eine VR Brille aufhatten.

Brilliant fun!  It’s the sort of game that gets your heart racing and your body moving, even if you look like a complete lunatic to anyone watching you. Great for a laugh, a bit of exercise, and getting the adrenaline going. Who needs a gym membership when you can run for your life in VR? Five stars from me!

FINALLY able to download the game after the storefront glitch debacle. Graphics are so crisp and bright. Gameplay/movement is intuitive and engaging. Music is motivating. I'm excited to add this to my gamercising lineup!

Update: Whew! This is a serious cardio workout. The shadow over your shoulder getting closer and closer is a nice touch. If VR fitness is your thing, this app is a must-have!

Excellent, fun game that gives you a real cardio workout. The gameplay mechanics are well-implemented with jumping, ducking, walls that require poses (e.g. O-Shape) in addition to running. It really does have a "Temple Run in VR" feel to it. Being chased by a monster also adds a sense of urgency to motivate you to run faster. Highly recommended!

This is fun and intense as you can "feel" the monsters closing in as their shadows get visibly closer. You'll need to shoot at them to slow them down which is important as I was grabbed by Sobek more times than I want to admit.

Most of the movement is intuitive: however note that you must run with arm swings out in front of your headset to run faster. This makes sense but I naturally run with my arms closer to my face so I had to remember to make the physical adjustments.

The other thing I had to adapt to was the ducking, since the arms must still be moving. I imagined using battle ropes which worked well.

It's a great workout, especially with the wide arm swings, and truly gamifies exercise without any motion sickness. I can't wait to see where the dev takes it!

developer_response.body: Thanks for the great feedback. I tried lots of ways of tracking the arm movements but I had to be able to filter something that had  an obvious conversion of effort into speed and not just flapping arms. Glad you were able to adjust and are enjoying the game!

reviews.review_description: A really well made game that's not just fun for you but also good for you. Watch my review at https://youtu.be/G2dwG9vqEys highly recommend.
I'm really enjoying this fitness game.  I'm getting in some cardio in a fun way!  I feel like I am Super Mario as I collect the coins!

developer_response.body: Wahoooo! - thanks for a great review

reviews.review_description: Its just like temple run but scary in vr. Being able to shoot the monsters is such a cool idea! Takes 2 mintues to learn all the controls but it takes time to get good at it, its fun but in short bursts as you can get physically tired from all the action!

Fun game! If you ever had nightmares of things chasing after you, now you can turn around and shoot them and get some workout too. Running by moving your arms feels natural and surprisingly immersive, and the different types of obstacles add a lot of variety.
